seo.title: Private Dentist in Battersea
seo.description: ProDenta is a private dental practice on St John's Hill, Battersea. General and cosmetic dentistry, Invisalign, implants and facial aesthetics.

hero.heading: Your dentist on St John's Hill
hero.text: ProDenta is a private dental practice in Battersea. We look after teeth, gums and skin, and we're open until 8pm three evenings a week.
hero.imageAlt: A woman with a warm, natural smile

welcome.heading: Prevention comes first here
paragraphs: ProDenta is on St John's Hill, opposite the St John's Therapy Centre. Clapham Junction and Wandsworth Town stations are each about ten minutes away on foot.

Most of what we do is ordinary dentistry done carefully: check-ups, hygiene visits and fillings. We explain what we find and what your options are before anything is done, and we show you how to stop the same problem coming back.

dental.heading: Dentistry
dental.text: Check-ups and hygiene, straightening, whitening, crowns and implants.
dental.imageAlt: A woman with a bright smile

aesthetics.heading: Skin and facial aesthetics
aesthetics.text: Injectable and skin treatments, carried out by our clinicians after a consultation.
aesthetics.imageAlt: A woman with healthy, glowing skin

offer.heading: Examination and hygiene visit
offer.text: A full examination and a hygiene clean for new patients.

items.title: Time to talk
items.text: Appointments are long enough to explain what we've found and to answer your questions.

items.title: Specialist treatment in-house
items.text: Orthodontics, root canal treatment, implants and oral surgery are all done at the practice.

items.title: Evenings and Saturdays
items.text: Open until 8pm on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays, and from 9am to 3pm on Saturdays.

items.title: Families welcome
items.text: We see children and adults, and many of our patients come as a family.
